description: List filers with official identity (congressional filers carry their Bioguide ID; executive-branch filers return null with an explanation — identifiers are never invented). Filter by bioguide, by the exact member_id a disclosure row carries, or by a substring of the name as filed. A name search can match several filers; each result carries member_id and bioguide for an exact match.

member_id.description: Exact filer identifier from a disclosure row, e.g. nancy-pelosi

name.description: Case-insensitive substring of the filer's full name, e.g. pelosi

name: list_members

chamber.description: House, Senate or executive-branch filer class from the directory; null when unavailable.

coverage.description: Existing directory coverage semantics retained. In the paginated response, read at coverage.served_at in the same statement as identity.

average_filing_delay_days.description: Directory aggregate of transaction-to-filing days, rounded by the existing SQL view; null without measured intervals. Not a timeliness verdict.

disclosures_available.description: Rows counted by the existing directory's candidate-view aggregate for this member, not a separately pinned API-version count.

filings_pending_qualification.description: Nonnegative difference between directory total held rows and candidate aggregate rows; not a per-reason exclusion census.

filings_pending_receipt.description: Pending-receipt rows reported by the directory's latest member coverage observation, or its executive-branch receipt predicate; not distinct document count.

latest_filed_date.description: Maximum filing date among this member's directory candidate rows; null without one.

district.description: House district as `STATE-N`, 0 for an at-large seat; null for senators and executive-branch filers. The same form every disclosure row's member.district uses.

full_name.description: Name carried by the existing directory; null when unavailable.

identity.description: Directory identity join, independent of financial disclosure counts.

bioguide.description: Mapped official congressional Bioguide ID, or null when unmapped or inapplicable.

note.description: Explanation of a missing identity mapping; null when an identifier is present.

system.description: Identifier namespace, not a statement that every filer has an identifier in it.

member_id.description: Filer identifier from the directory; the ascending key for opt-in pagination.

paper_transcriptions.description: This known filer's paper queue state from the independent paper measurement, without changing directory disclosure counts.

known_pending_documents.description: Observed outstanding queue records for this member, including unreconciled records; null when coverage is unavailable, and never a count of the uninspected population.

measured_at.description: Timestamp inherited from the same coverage/counts RPC, canonical UTC Z; null when the read could not complete.

member_id.description: Canonical member identifier requested by the member surface.

paper_rows_reason.description: Why the member's remaining transaction-row count is unavailable.

paper_rows_remaining.description: Unknown transaction rows remaining for this member; never estimated.

pending.description: Observed pending and terminal paper-queue filings for this member, including records whose index reconciliation is incomplete.

items.description: An outstanding PTR requiring verified transcription, with its official receipt, first terminal-outcome time and queue diagnosis. Parser failures do not attest paper.

active_followers.description: Distinct active consented member subscribers across paid preferences and confirmed free follows; aggregate only, or null when not measured.

filing_date.description: Filing date printed in the retained Clerk annual index, YYYY-MM-DD.

member.description: Member name from retained Clerk filing metadata.

member_id.description: Member route identifier, resolved through the existing member alias registry when available.

paper_rows.description: Unknown transaction-row count. PDF page counts and external trade counts are not substitutes.

paper_rows_reason.description: Why no transaction-row count is available.

queue_status.description: Outstanding transcription work or a retained terminal transcription failure.

reason.description: Named terminal queue diagnosis, or null when none is recorded.

receipt_url.description: Official Clerk PDF URL matching this DocID.

since.description: First instrumented terminal document outcome, canonical UTC Z. This does not measure filing discovery delay.

since_basis.description: Evidence defining the since timestamp; it is never backdated to the filing date. Parser failures do not attest absence of text.

state.description: The filing has no completed verified transcription recorded in this queue.

pending_documents.description: Member's total outstanding queue filings only when the full annual population is measured; otherwise null.

pending_documents_reason.description: Reason the member total is unknown, inherited from the same coverage measurement.

state.description: Pending transcription when at least one observed outstanding queue document exists; otherwise null, not a completeness claim.

party.description: Directory party label, or null without a mapping.

state.description: Directory state code, or null when unavailable or inapplicable.

directory.description: Which relation answered and how old it is. Present on every directory response so a reader never has to assume the age of what they were served.

fallback_reason.description: Why the live view answered, or null when the snapshot did. Published rather than hidden: a directory served from an unexpected source is a fact about this response.

max_age_seconds.description: The age past which the snapshot is refused and the live view answers instead. A bound this response was checked against, not a service commitment.

refreshed_at.description: When the snapshot rows in this response were copied from the view. Null when the live view answered, because a live read has no refresh instant to report.

source.description: Which relation answered. `snapshot` is the four-hourly copy of the directory view; `live_view` is the view itself, used whenever the snapshot cannot be trusted. Both carry identical rows by construction: the snapshot has no predicate of its own.

paper_transcriptions.description: Paper queue visibility independent of the directory population and measurement timestamp. Completeness state describes the annual paper measurement, not roster coverage.

archive_year.description: Clerk annual filing-index year being reconciled.

by_member.description: Observed paper filers matching the declared filter scope, including filers absent from the legacy roster when metadata supports matching. Does not add roster rows or alter directory counts.

items.description: Member projection of the shared House paper coverage measurement.

known_pending_documents.description: Observed outstanding queue records for this member, including unreconciled records; null when coverage is unavailable, and never a count of the uninspected population.

measured_at.description: Timestamp inherited from the same coverage/counts RPC, canonical UTC Z; null when the read could not complete.

member_id.description: Canonical member identifier requested by the member surface.

paper_rows_reason.description: Why the member's remaining transaction-row count is unavailable.

paper_rows_remaining.description: Unknown transaction rows remaining for this member; never estimated.

pending.description: Observed pending and terminal paper-queue filings for this member, including records whose index reconciliation is incomplete.

items.description: An outstanding PTR requiring verified transcription, with its official receipt, first terminal-outcome time and queue diagnosis. Parser failures do not attest paper.

active_followers.description: Distinct active consented member subscribers across paid preferences and confirmed free follows; aggregate only, or null when not measured.

filing_date.description: Filing date printed in the retained Clerk annual index, YYYY-MM-DD.

member.description: Member name from retained Clerk filing metadata.

member_id.description: Member route identifier, resolved through the existing member alias registry when available.

paper_rows.description: Unknown transaction-row count. PDF page counts and external trade counts are not substitutes.

paper_rows_reason.description: Why no transaction-row count is available.

queue_status.description: Outstanding transcription work or a retained terminal transcription failure.

reason.description: Named terminal queue diagnosis, or null when none is recorded.

receipt_url.description: Official Clerk PDF URL matching this DocID.

since.description: First instrumented terminal document outcome, canonical UTC Z. This does not measure filing discovery delay.

since_basis.description: Evidence defining the since timestamp; it is never backdated to the filing date. Parser failures do not attest absence of text.

state.description: The filing has no completed verified transcription recorded in this queue.

pending_documents.description: Member's total outstanding queue filings only when the full annual population is measured; otherwise null.

pending_documents_reason.description: Reason the member total is unknown, inherited from the same coverage measurement.

state.description: Pending transcription when at least one observed outstanding queue document exists; otherwise null, not a completeness claim.

filter_coverage.description: Paper metadata supports exact member, name and House chamber filters. State or Bioguide filters can only admit members proven by directory records in this response; their paper-only matches remain unknown.

filter_reason.description: Named limitation when directory identity is needed to evaluate filters, otherwise null. An empty restricted list is not proof that no matching paper filings exist.

filters.description: Member filters applied to the independent paper list; directory cursor and limit do not paginate this list.

bioguide.description: Requested Bioguide; requires a matching known directory record and is never invented for pending-only filers.

chamber.description: Requested chamber; this paper queue contains House documents only.

member_id.description: Exact canonical member filter, or null for all matching members.

name.description: Literal case-insensitive substring applied to retained paper member names, not a wildcard.

state.description: Requested state; requires a matching known directory record and is not inferred from a member name.

measured_at.description: Database transaction timestamp from the same RPC statement as these counts, canonical UTC Z; null when the read could not complete.

reason.description: Named reason for incomplete or unavailable measurement; null only when reconciled.

state.description: Whether the retained annual index and complete PDF inspection population reconcile, remain incomplete, or cannot be read.
